info.title: Box Ox developer API
info.description: Send, schedule and log mail, manage templates, webhooks, received mail and suppressions for one domain. Errors are `{error:{code,message,param?}}`. Lists use cursor pagination (`nextCursor`).

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Replays within 24 h return the original response; a different body gets 409.

429.description: Rate limit or daily cap reached

post.summary: Send up to 100 messages, all-or-nothing or partial (needs `send`)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Replays within 24 h return the original response; a different body gets 409.

202.description: Queued; `errors` lists skipped messages in partial mode

429.description: Rate limit or daily cap reached

get.summary: One message with its status timeline and rendered body (needs `read_log`)

patch.summary: Move a scheduled message's send time (needs `send`)

get.summary: Domain keys on the management key's domains

post.summary: Create a domain key (management keys only)

201.description: Created; the secret is shown once

post.summary: Issue a new secret; the old one works for the overlap window
Revoke a domain key at once

409.description: A template with this name exists

201.description: Created; the secret is shown once

get.summary: Live events on the key's domain over a WebSocket, for local development

101.description: Switching protocols; each text frame is a WebhookListenFrame

patch.summary: Change the URL or events, or enable/disable

post.summary: New signing secret; both sign during the overlap

get.summary: One delivery with its attempt log and payload
Mail received on the domain's app inboxes (needs `read_received`)
Parsed fields, authentication, bodies and attachments
A signed, expiring link to the original .eml
The signed .eml link itself; no API key, the token is the credential

delete.summary: Remove an address from our list (Cloudflare's still applies)

post.summary: An event delivered to your endpoint, signed with the endpoint's whsec_ secret

apiKey.description: A domain key (bxk_…) for mail routes, or a management key (bxm_…) for /dev/v1/keys.

Forbidden.description: The key may not do this

NotFound.description: Not found on this key's domain

CreatedKey.description: The full secret appears only in this response.

secret.description: whsec_… signing secret; shown only on create and rotate.

WebhookListenFrame.description: One event sent to `GET /dev/v1/webhooks/listen`. `payload` is the WebhookEvent JSON exactly as an endpoint would receive it.

WebhookEvent.description: The signed JSON body POSTed to a webhook endpoint (Standard Webhooks headers webhook-id, webhook-timestamp, webhook-signature).
